title: Facility failures caused by contaminated input material
observations: Equipment failures appear across otherwise independent lines.
Failures begin after a new batch of input material arrives.
Maintenance schedules and staffing are unchanged.
Laboratory analysis finds abrasive contamination in the input material.
participant_claims: Maintenance managers initially blame aging equipment.
researcher_interpretations: A physical-material mechanism outside the current organizational ontology may be causal.
assumptions: All persistent performance failures are primarily organizational.
missing_evidence: Failure rates after uncontaminated material is restored.
